active_probes.question: Can a formal Core and fifth-adapter contract represent development provenance plus raw, referenced, and derived experience without harness leakage or summary-for-source substitution?
Can Hermes perform a real P1 developed-state round trip against a pinned official contract with source immutability, privacy safety, and complete loss accounting?
Which persistent/contextual state is necessary for learned behavior to survive same-model fresh restore under the same evaluation?

epoch_goal: Prepare a publication-ready protocol timestamp and formal Core architecture, then prove Hermes P1 against a pinned official contract, while retaining the bootstrap only as validated evidence and preserving explicit unknowns about behavior portability.

experience_commitments.statement: Users can see what an image contains and its privacy/loss status without exposing private payload content.
Harness-native state is preserved honestly as typed native content when it cannot be normalized.
Every export, migration, and restore accounts for all source items without silent loss.

source.reference: 03_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA.md Gates C, E and false-completion rules

experience_commitments.statement: Portability claims are backed by P0-P3 evidence and never inferred from fixture or demo success.
Agent Image must preserve the semantics of what a developed agent has become rather than collapse into a starting profile, prompt bundle, skill pack, or whole-directory archive.
Raw experience, causal and temporal structure, replay material, and provenance remain preservable or referenceable; summaries are derived views and do not authorize source deletion.
A trained-agent portability claim requires an unchanged model, recorded practice, freeze, fresh restore, the same evaluation, and retained learned behavior.
Explorable World and Training Ground remain distinct Habitat categories; Agent Image preserves developed state without redefining either category as a v0.1 runtime feature.
Skill artifacts and acquired skill state remain distinct so the protocol cannot mistake a skills directory for a trained agent.

horizon_goal: Deliver a harness-neutral Agent Image v0.1 protocol and toolchain with real Hermes, OpenClaw, DSH, and vHarness adapters; at least three P1 native restores; one Hermes-to-OpenClaw P2 migration; privacy-safe inspect, verify, diff, and redact; a restored trained-agent demonstration; and a third-party-extensible registry.

open_design_options.statement: OCI may be added as a later transport without changing the logical image model.
Production adapters may be separate packages while conforming to the same core contract.
The final open-source license remains to be selected before release.
Context Body, Pulse Image, Reprise, replay, and consolidation may later map into or interoperate with Agent Image without becoming v0.1 schema promises.
vHabitat and Trainable Agent Team or Team Image remain long-horizon extensions and are not v0.1 blockers.
Skill-preserving, privacy-stripping export remains a future research and product option beyond v0.1 layer-level redaction.
Contextual Skill Attractor remains a benchmark-shaping research hypothesis and must not be encoded as established protocol fact.
